title: TrustGraph: Laya ONNX Decision Scoring, Temperature Clamping, Normalized Entropy Confidence & Head-Budgeting
summary: TrustGraph Laya (onnx-community/laya-multilingual-ONNX) scores structured routing decisions across three question types (choice=0, score=1, noul=2). Temperatures are safely sanitized and clamped to [0.5, 5.0] (NaN/Inf mapped to 1.0), quantized into temperature buckets, and scored with normalized Shannon entropy confidence (1 - H(p)/ln(k), returning 1.0 when k < 2). Sequence assembly enforces max_len=512 and head_max_len=192 with opt_budget = head_max_len - k * (1 + min(48, option_tokens_each)).
author: repo-triad-forge
distilled_learning: Quantify structured LLM/agent decision confidence using clamped temperature calibration, normalized Shannon entropy (1 - H(p)/ln(k)), and bounded option-header token budgeting.
